data: For the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023, Apple reported net sales of $383.3 billion ($383,285 million), down about 2.8% from $394.3 billion in fiscal 2022. Net income was $97.0 billion ($96,995 million), compared with $99.8 billion the prior year, a decline of roughly 2.8%. Total assets at fiscal year-end were $352.6 billion ($352,583 million), essentially flat against $352.8 billion at the end of fiscal 2022.
